thesis: The guest explains that he chose the handle 'Light Spring Fox' after seeing a top-ranked Bitmex leaderboard entry named 'Heavy Autumn Wolf,' which he viewed as a benchmark for professional success in crypto market making. He details his transition from traditional long-horizon equity factor investing to high-frequency crypto market making, noting that the high-frequency domain offers abundant data and faster statistical validation compared to the long-horizon approach.
